title: Armed robbery at Jayanagar jewellery store
summary: Three masked assailants breached a rear service door, took jewellery inventory, and escaped in a silver hatchback later found abandoned near Bommanahalli.

evidence.description: CAM-042 captured suspect vehicle leaving the service lane.
evidence.chain_of_custody: Collected by SI Manoj Bhat, sealed at 2026-07-18T03:10:00Z.

evidence.description: Silver hatchback KA-05-BX-2214 recovered abandoned near Bommanahalli.
evidence.chain_of_custody: Recovered by patrol PCR-42 and logged in seizure memo 42-A.

mo_pattern: Night entry through low-visibility service access, quick asset sweep, and secondary escape vehicle staging.

legal_mapping.title: Punishment for robbery
legal_mapping.rationale: Property taken by force with coordinated entry.

legal_mapping.title: Robbery with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt

fir_draft.accused: Ravi Naidu and two unidentified associates
fir_draft.statement: Unknown accused persons entered through the rear service door, threatened staff, and removed jewellery inventory before fleeing.

title: Cybercrime deepfake extortion
summary: Victims received AI-generated compromising videos and extortion demands routed over overseas VoIP and encrypted messaging accounts.

evidence.description: Sample deepfake extortion video hash collected from victim device.
evidence.chain_of_custody: Image and hash captured by cyber cell analyst under ticket DF-11.

evidence.description: Call detail record shows repeated overseas VoIP masking.
evidence.chain_of_custody: Telecom compliance response ingested under notice TR-008.

mo_pattern: Synthetic persona building, cloned media generation, and rapid demand escalation using anonymized calling paths.

legal_mapping.title: Violation of privacy
legal_mapping.rationale: Manipulated private imagery used in the extortion attempt.

fir_draft.accused: Unknown operator using overseas VoIP masking
fir_draft.statement: The accused transmitted manipulated digital media and demanded payment under threat of publication.
